nodes.name: Fetch Unseen Emails
nodes.notes: PENDING MANUAL STEP: Create an IMAP credential in n8n Settings > Credentials for vendor-bills@shiroienergy.com. Set host, port (993), TLS enabled, username, and app password. Credential name must match exactly.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ email_id: $json.source_email_id, sender_email: $json.sender_email, subject: $json.subject, body: $json.body, attachments: [{ filename: $json.safe_filename, base64: $json.attachment_base64 }] }) }}

nodes.name: POST to /api/vendor-invoices/ingest
nodes.notes: PENDING MANUAL STEP: Set ERP_URL n8n env var to https://erp.shiroienergy.com (or your Vercel preview URL for testing). N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET must match the env var in Vercel.

nodes.name: Mark Email as Read
nodes.notes: Marks the email as read only after a successful ingest. If UID is missing (some IMAP servers), this node will be a no-op — the email will be re-ingested on the next run but createDraftFromExtractedInvoice handles idempotency via ai_source_email_id.
